topic: SQL script modification for data consistency
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the `ds_copy.sql` script. [p1] questioned why certain parts related to `device_session_agg_ml_2` were commented out. Someone advised that uncommenting this section is recommended to ensure consistency between `ml_2` and `agg_5`. The default commenting was noted as a safeguard against accidental deletion of the predict function in `ml_2`.
decisions: Uncomment the parts related to device_session_agg_ml_2 in ds_copy.sql
